name: judgment
wording: once per cut, when the build is green, the held-out examples run and independent assayers, as many as proportionality sets, judge what cannot run: whether the work keeps to the operator's requirements and the lead's recorded decisions, and whether the examples still express their concepts. A finding against the work returns to the builders as a failing case, swept wherever the same defect occurs and confirmed on that finding alone; a doubt about an example, or two assayers disagreeing, goes to the architect as a meaning question; and a check is adequate when it rejects the plausible failures its example names, so a contrived way around it is future work on the check, never a finding against the work.
reason: Restated as current meaning only: plain words, with decision numbers, history and how it is built left out; its meaning is unchanged.
